name: 厚实加大无香成人湿巾款
description: 大尺寸厚实无纺布湿巾，居家清洁与外出应急多场景代入

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF packshot field, plus a rounded cyan #35C1EE or matte black #101014 inner panel inside a black frame, hairline capsule and column motifs
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool bright high-key studio light, large front-left key with bounce fill, soft contact shadows, skimming side sweep only on texture close-ups
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte board fields: seamless white #FFFFFF, mist grey #EDF1F4, matte black #101014; porcelain and clear-water surfaces in scene panels
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif grid kept as empty headline plates and blank label capsules, no rendered glyphs
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line single-weight icons in cyan #35C1EE only, outline style, used as blank framed slots
styleLock.presentationRules: locked product scale and slight 3/4 to straight-on angle across the set, packs always grounded by a contact shadow, sheet texture shown flat and un-stretched
noDrift: no mixed fonts or rendered lettering
no filled-in badges, seals or spec numbers
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent bold high-contrast hygiene-care ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF field, electric cyan #35C1EE inner panel, matte black #101014 frame and mist grey #EDF1F4 secondary surface; cool bright high-key studio lighting with a large front-left key and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif layout kept as empty plates; rounded capsule and column motifs with a single hairline outline; thin-line outline icons in one accent colour only; stable locked product scale and slight 3/4 to straight-on angle; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no rendered text or invented badges.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用整组堆叠传达囤货量感与翻盖包装结构。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, stacked packs behind one upright front pack, full units visible
shots.lighting: cool even high-key studio light, front-left key with bounce card, soft contact shadows
shots.whitespace: even margin around the whole stack, no internal whitespace
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Several identical soft packs stacked horizontally behind one upright pack shown straight-on at eye level, all units fully visible and evenly spaced on a seamless pure white #FFFFFF field. Cool even high-key studio light from the front-left with a bounce card on the shadow side, soft contact shadows grounding every pack, crisp sealed edges. The stacked group occupies 60-70% of the frame with an even margin all round and no extra whitespace inside the silhouette. Square 1:1 composition, 4K commercial hygiene-care catalogue quality. Negative: no added lettering or glyphs beyond the product's own original label, no invented badges or seal artwork, no quantity or size numerals, no props, no hands, no gradient or tinted background, no floating packs without contact shadow, no duplicated pack elements, no watermark, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 把外出尴尬瞬间具象化，一眼让买家代入并引出抽取动作。
shots.camera: slight 3/4 eye-level on the torso, hands and opened pack, head out of frame
shots.lighting: cool soft front-left key, gentle shadow under the hand, even panel lighting
shots.background: rounded cyan #35C1EE inner panel inside a matte black #101014 frame
shots.props: white trousers with a thick brown smear stain on the back pocket, nothing else
shots.whitespace: clean empty headline plate across the top band and one blank sub-caption plate above the panel
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point screen of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Inside a rounded cyan #35C1EE panel set in a matte black #101014 frame, a figure in white trousers shown from the shoulders down at a slight 3/4 eye-level angle, one hand lifting a single sheet from the opened flip-lid pack held in the other hand, a thick brown smear stain sitting on the back pocket as the problem cue. Cool soft front-left key light with a gentle shadow under the hand. The figure and pack together occupy 40-50% of the frame, with a clear empty headline plate across the top band and one blank capsule plate above the panel, both kept glyph-free. Negative: no recognisable face or likeness, no deformed or extra fingers, no readable text in either plate, no invented ingredient or tolerance claims, no mould, no insects or contamination cues, no dirty laundry staging, no watermark, no product covering the stain.

shots.intent: 用夸张幽默的卫浴桥段锁定使用情境，并在下方留出一排空胶囊承接卖点。
shots.camera: very low angle looking slightly upward at the toilet, pack raised into frame
shots.lighting: cool bright directional key from the front-right, soft shadow on the porcelain
shots.background: matte black #101014 backdrop with a cyan #35C1EE hairline panel border
shots.props: white ceramic toilet with lid raised, a row of empty capsule frames along the lower band
shots.whitespace: clear headline plate across the top plus a blank capsule row beneath the scene
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene of {product} staged in a bathroom set-up. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A white ceramic toilet with the lid raised, photographed from a very low angle looking slightly upward, one arm rising from the bowl holding the pack upright; the scene sits on a matte black #101014 backdrop inside a rounded panel with a cyan #35C1EE hairline border. Cool bright directional key light from the front-right with a soft shadow falling on the porcelain. The toilet and pack occupy 40-50% of the frame, leaving a clean headline plate across the top and a row of empty capsule outlines along the lower band for copy placement. Negative: no visible face, no dirty or stained bowl, no splashing water artefacts, no shortened or fused fingers, no readable words inside the capsules, no certification or test seals, no invented badges, no watermark, no props crowding the product.

shots.intent: 三人对称构图制造社交代入感，用干净与狼狈两种状态讲同一件事。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level group framing, flanking figures cropped from the neck down
shots.lighting: cool soft frontal lighting, matched on all three figures, gentle contact shadows
shots.background: rounded cyan #35C1EE panel inside a matte black #101014 frame
shots.props: white trousers and shorts, one pair carrying a brown smear stain, opened pack at the waist
shots.whitespace: empty headline plate above the group, quiet corners left for copy
shots.promptTemplate: Buyer-life group scene for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Three figures arranged symmetrically inside a rounded cyan #35C1EE panel on a matte black #101014 frame, photographed straight-on at eye level: the two flanking figures cropped from the neck down in white trousers, one clean and one carrying a thick brown smear stain, while the central figure holds an opened pack low at the waist and lifts one sheet. Cool soft frontal lighting matched across all three figures with gentle contact shadows. The group occupies 40-50% of the frame with an empty headline plate kept clear above them. Negative: no recognisable face or likeness, no heads left in frame, no fused or extra fingers, no readable lettering, no brand jewellery, no invented skin-comfort claims, no duplicated figures, no mismatched shadows, no watermark.

shots.intent: 把巾体尺寸与覆盖面积讲清楚，消除会不会太小的规格疑虑。
shots.camera: photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead flat lay
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting from above, soft edge shadows only
shots.background: matte black #101014 field with a cyan #35C1EE hairline border
shots.props: two unfolded sheets of different area, one plain rolled paper cylinder centred on each, two blank rounded label plates
shots.whitespace: matched gutter between the two sheets, empty headline plate at the top
shots.promptTemplate: Overhead specification flat lay of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Two unfolded sheets laid side by side on a matte black #101014 field with a cyan #35C1EE hairline border, photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, one sheet clearly larger in area than the other, a plain rolled paper cylinder centred on each sheet as a neutral scale anchor, matched crop and matched lighting on both sides. Even high-key flat light from above with soft edge shadows only. The two sheets occupy 50-60% of the frame, each sitting above one empty rounded label plate kept glyph-free. Negative: no wordmarks or brand plates, no competitor naming or implied rival, no measurable callout numbers or dimension lines, no crushed or wrinkled sheets, no floating sheets without contact shadow, no readable text, no watermark, no duplicated sheets.

shots.intent: 用纤维与压边微距证明厚实度与用料质感。
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro at a low 15-degree skim angle, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: cool soft key with a skimming sweep from the right revealing fibre relief
shots.whitespace: minimal, the texture itself is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of a single sheet drawn from {product}, tight zoom on the nonwoven face and the embossed edge. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Camera positioned at a low 15-degree skim angle just above the surface with shallow depth of field, the near fibres sharp and the far edge falling off. Cool soft key with a skimming sweep of light from the right revealing fibre relief, set on a mist grey #EDF1F4 matte card. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame with minimal whitespace. Negative: no blurry subject, no plastic-looking textile, no lint clumps or fuzz noise, no wet shine puddles, no invented embossed pattern, no added props, no readable text, no watermark, no duplicated edge.

shots.intent: 保留三栏并置对照的说服结构，用空白样牌承接各自主张。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level triptych, identical framing and crop on all three columns
shots.lighting: cool front light matched across columns, faint reflections on the water surface
shots.background: cyan #35C1EE field divided by matte black #101014 column rules
shots.props: three clear water columns, blank rounded label plates above each, empty footnote strip below
shots.whitespace: clear headline plate above the triptych, thin empty footnote strip beneath it
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce comparison infographic built as three matched vertical columns with identical framing, crop and exposure. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. {product} appears as one specimen suspended in a clear water column, filmed straight-on at eye level against a cyan #35C1EE field divided by matte black #101014 column rules; each column carries one blank rounded label plate at the top and one empty footnote strip at the bottom. Cool front light matched across all three columns with faint reflections on the water surface. Each specimen occupies 45-50% of its column. Negative: no readable words on any plate or strip, no before-and-after result claims, no implied competitor identity or rival packaging, no laboratory or certification references, no duplicated bubble patterns, no warped column lines, no watermark.

shots.intent: 以包装背板结构收口，把说明区与标识区留成空白证据位降低风险感。
shots.camera: photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, pack laid flat
shots.lighting: even soft high-key light, faint contact shadow beneath the pack
shots.props: three empty text blocks, one blank seal box, one blank rounded ingredient frame on the pack panel
shots.whitespace: generous white margin around the pack, no copy rendered
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen showing the reverse panel of {product} laid flat on a seamless pure white #FFFFFF field. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, crimped seals at both short sides, the panel divided into three clean empty text blocks, one small blank seal box and one blank rounded ingredient frame, all held as empty proof placeholders for post-production. Even soft high-key lighting with a faint contact shadow under the pack. The pack occupies 60-70% of the frame with generous white margin around it. Negative: no readable instructions or warnings, no ingredient lists or company names, no country flags or origin marks, no barcode digits, no certification seals or award icons, no invented test data, no QR codes, no watermark, no hand entering frame.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：图1 白底多包横向堆叠＋前方一只翻盖单包；图2 黑框青底面板，白色裤装后袋深褐污渍、双手抽巾，顶部与胶囊位为纯文字主张；图3 马桶抬盖、手臂自便器中举起包装，下方一排胶囊标签；图4 三栏水中小样并置对照，底部极小脚注；图5 俯视平铺两张大小区分的巾体，各压一枚卷状尺度道具，下方两组字标；图6 三人对称构图，两侧仅躯干、中央人物持巾持包且露脸；图7 白底包装背板，密集说明文字块、产地标识与成分框。品类判定：主体为无纺布抽取式清洁湿巾（耗材纸品），既非着色彩妆也非护肤精华，故按图取 L1 家居日用 / L2 纸品清洁，与源类目倾向一致，leaf 取成人加厚湿巾。已剥离：全部品牌字标与系列名、包装上的数量与规格数字、可冲性与分解类断言、皮肤科与检测类字样、无添加类主张、胶囊标签原句、脚注与星号条款、产地旗帜标识、成分与使用说明文字块、模特面容与身份、手部特写身份、原平台店铺字样与角标；所有主张位改为空白胶囊框、空白标签板与留白证据位，产品一律以 {product} 占位；图1 与图2 的抽取动作与图6 躯干姿态仅保留构图结构。
